security_privacy_review: Required before production enablement; verify current security/privacy terms and relevant data-handling commitments
continuity_review: Verify service continuity assumptions, model availability dependencies and failure behavior before production reliance
provider_independence_review: Required: record provider/model independence domain, substitution constraints and whether second-opinion/fallback paths are genuinely independent
reassessment_triggers: Provider terms/data-use change; model/rate-card/version change; outage/incident; production enablement; acquisition-mode change; new consequential use
exit_or_fallback_criteria: Provider can remain disabled; fallback/alternate provider must be separately governed and evidence-backed; preserve data/export/deactivation implications

security_privacy_review: Review database platform security controls, service-role exposure, Data API configuration, backup/recovery and current security-advisor findings
continuity_review: High continuity dependency; require tested backup/restore and migration/exit evidence before production autonomy
provider_independence_review: Provider-independent PostgreSQL architecture helps portability but managed-platform features and operational coupling must be identified
reassessment_triggers: Security/Data API change; migration/deployment; region/subprocessor/terms change; outage/incident; backup/restore or exit test
exit_or_fallback_criteria: Exit readiness requires tested export/restore, credential rotation, dependent-service inventory, downtime/RTO assumptions and alternate PostgreSQL target validation

security_privacy_review: Review repository/Actions/Codespaces security model, secret handling, access ownership and evidence-retention dependencies
continuity_review: High development/evidence continuity dependency; repository portability alone does not preserve issue/PR/Actions history
provider_independence_review: No AI model arbitration dependency, but governance must account for development-platform concentration and evidence custody
reassessment_triggers: Platform/terms change; CI incident; secret exposure; repository visibility/ownership change; Actions/Codespaces dependency change
exit_or_fallback_criteria: Maintain git-portable source and reproducible build/runtime contracts; separately plan export/retention for issues, PRs, workflow evidence and protected secrets

security_privacy_review: Manage package supply-chain risk through lockfile integrity, dependency review, vulnerability evidence and package ownership/change awareness
continuity_review: Registry/package availability affects build/recovery; offline/cache/alternate registry recovery not established
provider_independence_review: No model-provider independence role except packages that implement provider adapters; adapter packages must not become hidden authority
reassessment_triggers: Dependency update; vulnerability/advisory; package compromise/ownership event; registry outage; integrity mismatch
exit_or_fallback_criteria: Lockfile and source pinning reduce drift; exit/fallback criteria include alternate registry/cache or vendoring strategy if continuity risk becomes material
